This data set contains the point cloud created from the photogrammetric data collected of Avadlek Spit, June 2022. The data was collected by the Capture2Preserv Team and the Yukon Government with the Sensefly Ebee Geo Fixed Wing Drone and Sensefly's eMotion software. The data was processed in Pix4D Mapper.
